reason: I'd open the free version if a friend sent me the link and try basil pork, but I'm not paying for a pack that doesn't exist yet. Five free dishes is already enough to keep me busy for a month, if I even keep using it.
objection: Pre-ordering something that isn't out yet from an app I just found. I delete most apps after a week, so why pay before I know I'll still be cooking with it.
would_change_my_mind: If I actually cook the free dishes and they come out good, and the 12 dishes are ready to use right away, I'd pay 99 baht since it's one time and not a subscription.
